title: Jubilant Dutch Fettuccine Pasta
description: A halal-friendly Dutch dish featuring fettuccine, perfect for a funky brunch mood, simmered to perfection with a bouncy qq twist.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
In a large saucepan, combine the chicken broth, shredded dutch cheese, salt, and black pepper, and stir over low heat until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Add the cooked fettuccine to the cheese sauce and toss to combine, ensuring the pasta is well coated.
Transfer the fettuccine to the skillet with the onion and garlic, and toss to combine.
Simmer the fettuccine mixture over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the flavors are well combined and the pasta is heated through.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
